The atmosphere that surrounds the earth acts like the glass or plastic roof and wall of a green house. When solar energy reaches the earth passing through the atmosphere surrounding the earth, the COD water vapour, etc. present in the atmosphere absorb most of the solar energy and gets heated and excited. The excess energy present in them is converted into heat. consequently, the earth is warmed up resulting with the increase of earth's temperature.

However, when earth cools, the energy is re-emitted from the earth's surface in the form of infrared radiation and some is absorbed by atmospheric carbon dioxide and water vapours but can't pass through them and once again radiated back to the surface of the earth. In this way, additional heat is kept in the lower atmosphere resulting in the warming of the earth which is called green house effect.

What is an ozone layer? The layer above the earth surface which protects the harmful gases coming from sun is called ozone layer. It lies in the stratosphere bebveen 12 to 24 Km from the earth surface. The concentration of ozone layer in the stratosphere is about IQ ppm but near the earth surface it is found only about 0.04 ppm.
